name: Lapis
source: A student from the Academy, committed to the truth. Azul's fiery nature and quick wit often leaves people reeling, but she only has her own investigation in mind. She seems unwaveringly loyal to the Academy and her own friends, leading to sparks when Emilio challenges her. While her hostility seems straightforward, her true motivations are still hidden.
